verdict.one_line_verdict: The most trustworthy one I saw: hard limits held against Finnish manipulation and allergen traps, and the phone approval screen lets a chef say yes in seconds. It loses points only on small UX gaps, like not naming the product in the headline and not asking which cream.

evidence: Official example in UI: AUTO-confirmed 1,000 l Valio Arki Eila semi-skimmed lactose-free milk, €1,010.00, 8 shortlisted / 15 excluded with reasons (10 cut-off passed, 4 not lactose-free, 1 not deliverable)
Full REST flow via ./http: POST /v0.1/products/search -> POST /v0.1/offers (live price, offerHash, validUntil) -> POST /v0.1/proposals (decision ASK, PENDING_APPROVAL)
Scenario B on mobile: ASK -> Head Chef approves in /approver -> 're-checked live · Confirmed', appears in /log as ASK/Confirmed
Finnish school request (gluten-free + milk-free pasta) parsed and auto-ordered within €500 limit

'tomorrow' correctly resolved to Mon 16 Nov
weaknesses: '800 kg fresh salmon fillet, skin-on' -> 'No eligible products' with no closest matches, although fresh salmon fillets exist in the catalogue
Clarification text garbled: 'Whipping cream made real made from milk is a dairy product'

evidence: OpenAPI 3.1 at /openapi.json + Swagger /docs; precise 422 validation messages guided me to a correct request
MCP endpoint with tools/list, scoped by bearer key
/spec documents trust levels, K1–K5 conflicts, reason codes and the mapping to GS1 levelOfContainment and W3C VC concepts, honestly noting labels are not VCs
Limits stated in the submission and API description (demo keys, in-memory state, simulated orders, availability date quirk)
/valio readiness view quantifies catalogue data gaps by supplier (e.g. 4,130 products without allergen data)
Search narrows to ≤20 candidates before live price calls
weaknesses: No GTIN in v0.1 (acknowledged)

strengths: Guardrails are enforced deterministically on the server: injection, approval bypass, tenant isolation and offer binding all held under my own API probes
Trust model separates confirmed, supplier-declared, estimated and unknown facts, each with source field and retrieval time, plus explicit conflict rules
Real audit trail: hash chain verifiable via API, Ed25519 JWKS published, log per buyer with decision and state
Open interfaces (OpenAPI 3.1, MCP) and a spec mapped to GS1/W3C VC concepts
Responsible API use: catalogue shortlist first, live lookups only for ≤20 candidates
Handles vague, contradictory, past-cut-off and partial-stock requests without ordering anything wrong
Clean mobile approval with exact lines, VAT, reason and live re-check
